title: Artificial Intelligence Automated Telephone Consultations for Week 1 Post Surgery Cataract Surgery Patients
official: Artificial Intelligence Automated Telephone Consultations for Week 1 Post-Cataract Surgery Patients
summary: This clinical trial evaluates the safety, effectiveness, and acceptability of Dora, an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven conversational assistant, for conducting automated telephone consultations with patients one week after cataract surgery. Dora contacts patients by telephone to conduct a standardized post-operative assessment, identifying potential complications and concerns. The study enrolls patients in two phases: Phase 1 includes English-speaking participants and Phase 2 includes Spanish-speaking participants. The primary goal is to determine whether AI-automated telephone follow-up can safely and effectively identify post-operative issues requiring clinical attention while being acceptable to patients and clinicians.
criteria:
IInclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 years or older
* Scheduled for or has undergone cataract surgery with no intraoperative complications
* English-speaking (Phase 1) or Spanish-speaking (Phase 2)
* Willing and able to provide informed consent
* Able to receive and participate in a telephone call
* Able to comply with study procedures and follow-up requirements

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cataract surgery with intraoperative complications
* Significant ocular comorbidities (e.g., infectious ocular conditions)
* History of current severe, unstable, or uncontrolled systemic disease
* Conditions precluding ability to comply with study or follow-up procedures
* Unable to participate in a telephone conversation (e.g., hearing impairment preventing phone use)
